canonicalSelectedDeclarations.name: Sigma_catd_transport_func
canonicalSelectedDeclarations.text:
symbol Sigma_catd_transport_func [K : Cat] [R : τ (Catd K)]
  (FF : τ (Functord R (@Const_catd K Cat_cart))) [x y : τ (Obj K)]
  (p : τ (Hom K x y)) (r : τ (Obj (Fibre_cat R x)))
  : τ
    (Functor
     (Fibre_cat (@Sigma_catd_functord_catd K R FF) (Struct_sigma x r))
     (Fibre_cat (@Sigma_catd_functord_catd K R FF)
      (Struct_sigma y
       (@fapp0 (Fibre_cat R x) (Fibre_cat R y)
        (@catd_transport_func K R x y p) r))))
  ≔ @fapp1_fapp0 (@Sigma_cat K R) Cat_cart (@Sigma_catd_functord_catd K R FF)
    (Struct_sigma x r)
    (Struct_sigma y
     (@fapp0 (Fibre_cat R x) (Fibre_cat R y) (@catd_transport_func K R x y p)
      r))
    (@sigma_transport_arrow K R x y p r);

  ≔ @strict_transfor K Cat_cart E
    (fapp0 (Homd_target_index_func K) (@Homd_coeff_diagram K D))
    (@homd_rel_cart_int K D E FF);
